summary: Returns how many days the month of a date has.
description: Leap years are handled by the calendar itself, so February is 29 days where it should be. Only the month and the year of the date matter; the day and the time are ignored.

params.date: The date to read. It must be a valid `Date`.

returns: the number of days, from 28 to 31.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: an argument is not a valid `Date`.
